steps.code:
import os

base_dir = '/home/sierra/documents/work/meetings_data/'
files = [entry for entry in directory if not entry.endswith('/')]

for file_path in files:
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    name, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
    date_part, file_name_part = name.split('__', 1)
    
    new_dir = os.path.join(base_dir, file_name_part)
    new_file_path = os.path.join(new_dir, date_part + ext)
    
    print(f'Creating directory: {new_dir}')
    create_dir_response = apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=new_dir, access_token=access_token, recursive=True)
    print(create_dir_response)
    
    print(f'Moving file from {file_path} to {new_file_path}')
    move_response = apis.file_system.move_file(source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=new_file_path, access_token=access_token)
    print(move_response)
